name_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦·卡里莫夫：铁腕棉花与水世俗治理
name_en: Uzbekistan Karimov: Iron Fist Cotton Water Secular Governance
description_zh: 伊斯拉姆·卡里莫夫 (1938-2016) 乌兹别克斯坦首任总统 (1991-2016)，以铁腕手段维持稳定，依靠棉花出口与水资源控制建立经济基础，推行世俗化压制伊斯兰激进主义，建立高度集权的后苏联治理模式。
description_en: Islam Karimov (1938-2016) Uzbekistan first President (1991-2016), maintained stability with iron fist, built economic base on cotton export and water control, enforced secularization suppressing Islamic radicalism, established highly centralized post-Soviet governance model.
reason_zh: 卡里莫夫代表后苏联中亚威权稳定模式，展示了资源型经济(棉花/水)如何支撑世俗独裁，同时在大国博弈中通过平衡外交维持战略自主。
reason_en: Karimov represents post-Soviet Central Asian authoritarian stability model, demonstrating how resource economy (cotton/water) supports secular dictatorship while maintaining strategic autonomy through balanced diplomacy in great power competition.
steps_zh: 研究卡里莫夫早年苏共机械工程师与党内晋升
分析1991独立后棉花单一经济与阿姆河锡尔河水资源控制
探讨安集延事件与伊斯兰激进主义镇压
评估世俗宪法与宗教事务委员会双重控制机制
总结2016逝世后米尔济约耶夫改革开放转型
steps_en: Study Karimov early Soviet mechanical engineer and Party rise
Analyze 1991 post-independence cotton mono-economy and Amu Darya Syr Darya water control
Explore Andijan events and Islamic radicalism suppression
Evaluate secular constitution and Religious Affairs Committee dual control mechanism
Summarize 2016 death and Mirziyoyev reform opening transition
expected_zh: 理解资源型威权如何通过世俗化实现稳定，掌握中亚水资源地缘政治博弈逻辑，评估卡里莫夫模式对后继者改革的制约与启示。
expected_en: Understand how resource authoritarianism achieves stability through secularization, grasp Central Asian water geopolitics logic, evaluate Karimov model constraints and lessons for successor reforms.
case_zh: 1991 卡里莫夫当选总统；1992 宪法确立世俗制；2005 安集延事件镇压；2016 逝世。铁腕棉花水世俗治理范式永存。
case_en: 1991 Karimov elected President; 1992 Constitution established secularism; 2005 Andijan events suppression; 2016 death. Iron fist cotton water secular governance paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Authoritarian stability model; cotton economy; water geopolitics; secularism enforcement
